{"candidate_rtl":"module crc32_d8(input wire [7:0] data_in, input wire [31:0] state_in, output wire [7:0] data_out, output wire [31:0] state_out);\nwire [31:0] s0, s1, s2, s3, s4, s5, s6, s7, s8;\nwire f0, f1, f2, f3, f4, f5, f6, f7;\nassign s0 = state_in;\nassign f0 = s0[0] ^ data_in[7];\nassign s1 = (s0 >> 1) ^ ({32{f0}} & 32'hedb88320);\nassign f1 = s1[0] ^ data_in[6];\nassign s2 = (s1 >> 1) ^ ({32{f1}} & 32'hedb88320);\nassign f2 = s2[0] ^ data_in[5];\nassign s3 = (s2 >> 1) ^ ({32{f2}} & 32'hedb88320);\nassign f3 = s3[0] ^ data_in[4];\nassign s4 = (s3 >> 1) ^ ({32{f3}} & 32'hedb88320);\nassign f4 = s4[0] ^ data_in[3];\nassign s5 = (s4 >> 1) ^ ({32{f4}} & 32'hedb88320);\nassign f5 = s5[0] ^ data_in[2];\nassign s6 = (s5 >> 1) ^ ({32{f5}} & 32'hedb88320);\nassign f6 = s6[0] ^ data_in[1];\nassign s7 = (s6 >> 1) ^ ({32{f6}} & 32'hedb88320);\nassign f7 = s7[0] ^ data_in[0];\nassign s8 = (s7 >> 1) ^ ({32{f7}} & 32'hedb88320);\nassign data_out = {f7, f6, f5, f4, f3, f2, f1, f0};\nassign state_out = s8;\nendmodule","bottleneck":"The baseline infers forty wide XOR reductions from generated masks, with long reconvergent XOR and buffer paths for the CRC state outputs.","rewrite":"Replace the generic parameterized mask generator with an explicit eight-stage reflected CRC network. Each stage shares one feedback bit between the state update and the data output, uses the reflected polynomial 32'hedb88320, and exposes the shift structure directly to synthesis.","expected_timing_gain":"Expected modest improvement in maximum data arrival from reduced mask-generation fan-in and explicit feedback sharing; the exact gain depends on ABC restructuring and SKY130 cell mapping.","area_or_other_cost":"Likely lower or comparable mapped area than the 2502.4um2 baseline, with eight serialized feedback stages and no generic helper logic. The design remains below the 2752.64um2 area cap if mapping preserves the stated sharing.","functional_boundaries":"For every binary data_in and state_in value, this implements the fixed crc32_d8 instance exactly: reflected state initialization, MSB-first consumption of data_in[7:0], feedback sequence on data_out[0] through data_out[7], and final reflected CRC state on state_out. No parameterized behavior, latency, storage, or operational assumptions are introduced."}
